records.name: 17 FRIAR LANE
records.use: town house; later used as offices
records.field_evidence: Historic England describes 17 Friar Lane as a town house built in 1750 with rear C19 extensions; its official details describe a three-storey, five-bay Georgian house.

records.name: 102 AND 104, WELFORD ROAD
records.field_evidence: Historic England identifies 102 and 104 Welford Road as late-C18 red brick houses, three storeys and basement, with sash windows and a slate hipped roof.

records.name: FORMER CHARLES STREET POLICE STATION
records.field_evidence: Historic England identifies the former Charles Street Police Station as a 1933 police station by G Noel Hill and A T Gooseman, with later alterations not of special interest.
